description: This file defines the AccountProxy class in Drupal, implementing a proxy pattern for user account management, including methods for account handling, role and permission checks, and user entity loading.

classes.name: AccountProxy
classes.description: A proxy implementation of AccountInterface to manage user account access efficiently and avoid global state issues in Drupal.

methods.name: setAccount
methods.description: Sets the current account, dispatching an event and preventing proxy loops.

methods.name: getAccount
methods.description: Retrieves the current account, loading it if necessary.

methods.name: getRoles
methods.description: Gets roles associated with the current account.

methods.name: hasRole
methods.description: Checks if the account has a specific role.

methods.name: hasPermission
methods.description: Checks if the account has a specific permission.

methods.name: isAuthenticated
methods.description: Checks if the account is authenticated.

methods.name: isAnonymous
methods.description: Checks if the account is anonymous.

methods.name: getPreferredAdminLangcode
methods.description: Gets the preferred admin language code.

methods.name: setInitialAccountId
methods.description: Sets the initial account ID before an account is loaded.

methods.name: loadUserEntity
methods.description: Loads a user entity by ID using Drupal's entity type manager.
